description: Ask the Developer a question on the dashboard, with 2 to 4 short choices they can click (they can also answer in their own words), instead of stopping in the chat. Use it for product and UX choices only they can make; carry on with other work meanwhile. Their answer reaches you at your next Progressor call, under 'New from the Developer', and is kept as a decision on the Goal. While a question is open the dashboard shows the Goal as waiting on them. To take back a question that no longer needs an answer, pass withdraw with its ID instead.

choices.description: 2 to 4 short answers to pick from, such as ['On by default', 'Follow the computer'].

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

question.description: The question, in one plain sentence a non-programmer understands.

task.description: The ID of the Task it is about, such as 't3'.

withdraw.description: The ID of an open question to withdraw (such as 'q2'), instead of asking a new one.

name: ask_developer
title: Ask the Developer
